def order(api, customer_id, *items):
    return api.orders.handle_create({"customer_id": customer_id,
                                     "items": [{"sku": s, "quantity": q} for s, q in items]})


def test_unknown_customer_is_not_found(shop):
    response = shop.insights.handle_order_history("nobody")
    assert response.status == 404
    assert response.body == {"error": "customer not found"}


def test_customer_with_no_orders_gets_empty_list(shop):
    response = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c1")
    assert response.status == 200
    assert response.body == {"customer_id": "c1", "orders": []}


def test_orders_are_newest_first_and_include_cancelled(shop):
    first = order(shop, "c1", ("BOOK", 1)).body["order_id"]
    second = order(shop, "c1", ("PEN", 2)).body["order_id"]
    third = order(shop, "c1", ("LAMP", 1)).body["order_id"]
    shop.orders.handle_cancel(second)
    response = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c1")
    assert response.status == 200
    assert response.body == {
        "customer_id": "c1",
        "orders": [
            {"order_id": third, "status": "placed", "total_cents": 6_000},
            {"order_id": second, "status": "cancelled", "total_cents": 600},
            {"order_id": first, "status": "placed", "total_cents": 2_500},
        ],
    }


def test_only_the_requested_customers_orders_are_listed(shop):
    mine = order(shop, "c1", ("BOOK", 1)).body["order_id"]
    order(shop, "c2", ("BOOK", 1))
    response = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c1")
    assert [o["order_id"] for o in response.body["orders"]] == [mine]


def test_totals_include_discount_and_match_order_summary(shop):
    # Gold customer: 4 x 2500 = 10000 subtotal qualifies, 15% off => 8500.
    big = order(shop, "c2", ("BOOK", 4)).body["order_id"]
    # Standard customer: 2 x 2500 = 5000, below threshold => no discount.
    small = order(shop, "c1", ("BOOK", 2)).body["order_id"]

    history = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c2").body["orders"]
    assert history == [{"order_id": big, "status": "placed", "total_cents": 8_500}]
    assert history[0]["total_cents"] == shop.orders.handle_get(big).body["total_cents"]

    history = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c1").body["orders"]
    assert history[0]["order_id"] == small
    assert history[0]["total_cents"] == shop.orders.handle_get(small).body["total_cents"] == 5_000
